options.hanabiSettingsDesc: Tune Hanabi's fireworks, the camera's rise and spin, the lyrics and the PV collage.
options.hanabiChorusBloomHint: The whole picture glows during the chorus, swelling in as it starts and settling as it ends. Choruses come from the lyrics: marked by the source or found from repeated lines.
options.hanabiBloomHint: A full-screen glow over the whole song, under the chorus glow. 0 leaves only the chorus glow.
options.hanabiLaunchesHint: Each shell climbs from the bottom edge before it bursts, linking one shot to the next.
options.hanabiSkyHint: A night gradient under the fireworks. Lower it to let the shared background show through; below half, colors follow your theme background.
options.hanabiRiseSpeedHint: How far the camera climbs between shots. 0 keeps every shot in place.
options.hanabiSpinHint: Between shots the whole scene swings round by a large angle as it rises, and section changes turn too. 0 turns it off.
options.hanabiTextOnlyHint: Draws just the lyrics with their color blocks and letter motion. Fireworks, stickers, the night sky and the frame are hidden.
options.hanabiCollageHint: Film strips, cut lines, lace trims, repeated words, stickers, tape and theme icons around the lyrics.
options.hanabiColorModeHint: Mixed leans each shot's vivid palette toward your theme accent.
options.hanabiRenderQualityHint: Balanced and Low render the firework glow at reduced resolution, and Low also draws fewer ambient sparks; lyrics and the full-screen glow stay at full resolution. Worth trying if an integrated GPU stutters.
options.hanabiFontSizeAutoNotice: Hanabi sizes lyrics from the viewport and each shot's text region; the font size setting only affects the subtitles in this mode.
options.nebbiaAppearHint: Each line picks one of the writing styles that are on. With Fade in also on, it is used only for lines too quick to write out. The breath that clears a full screen is not affected.
options.nebbiaFadeHint: With both on, each line picks one at random.
options.nebbiaLayoutsHint: Each line takes the best fit among the compositions that are on; a line too long for any still goes in three rows.
options.nebbiaCredits: Write the title at the end
options.nebbiaCreditsHint: After the last line, the song title is written in the middle of the glass with the artist below, and stays until the song ends.
options.machiFontSizeAutoNotice: Machi fits the lyrics to the screens and signs in the scene; the generic font size setting only affects the subtitles in this mode.
options.machiSceneHint: Auto picks a scene for each song; the same song always gets the same one.
options.machiTimeOfDayHint: Auto follows your local clock: day, dusk or night.
options.machiWeatherHint: Auto picks the weather for each song. When it rains, lightning strikes at the start of each chorus.
options.machiCameraModeHint: Drag the picture to turn, scroll to zoom, right-drag (or use two fingers) to pan. Default view: about 8 seconds after you let go it returns to the default framing. Custom view: it stays where you leave it and is remembered, one for each scene; the sliders below adjust it too.
options.machiViewSceneHint: With the scene on Auto, whose view the sliders below adjust; by default the scene being shown.
options.machiCameraMotionHint: The camera slowly turns, pushes in and pulls back, and pans around the view, pausing with the song. Dragging stops it; it picks up again once the camera is back at the view.
options.machiApertureHint: Further right opens the aperture: a thinner slice in focus, everything else softer, and the lights and neon blur into round discs. f/8 is the original miniature look.
options.machiDofHint: The further from the focus, the softer; 0 turns it off.
options.machiTiltShiftHint: Softens the top and bottom of the picture, like a photo of a miniature.
options.machiFocusHint: Centre: the point the camera turns around. Lyric screen: the scene's lyric screen. Manual: moved nearer or further from the centre.
options.machiQualityHint: High, Balanced and Low are ready-made combinations; changing any option below makes it Custom. The frame-rate limit lives in Settings › Performance & motion and applies to every style.
options.machiRenderScaleHint: Draws at a share of the screen's pixels: lower is a little softer but much faster. On high-DPI screens it counts at most 2× the layout size.
options.machiAntialiasHint: FXAA is the cheapest but softens text slightly; SMAA gives clean edges and also smooths the ink lines and rain, at a little more cost; Supersampling draws at twice the resolution and scales down, the finest and the most expensive.
options.machiShadowsHint: Shadows cast by the moon and the sun.
options.machiReflectionsHint: Lights and signs reflected in the wet road; only drawn while the road is wet.
options.machiGlowHint: The halo around lights and signs at night, and the horizontal lens streaks.
options.machiAdaptiveHint: When the frame rate stays low, steps down below these settings (depth-of-field blur first, then reflections, shadows and glow, and only then anti-aliasing and resolution), never above what you chose. Changing a setting starts over from the new one.
options.sonnetPerformanceWarningDescript: Sonnet uses a high-density animated scene and can heavily load the GPU and CPU, causing severe stuttering on some devices. Lower texture resolution and use a static background such as Sora.

releaseNotes.v0_5_27.intro: Here are the new features and improvements in version 0.5.27.
releaseNotes.v0_5_27.diorama.title: Diorama 3D Lyrics Mode
releaseNotes.v0_5_27.diorama.description: Lyrics become 3D text in space as the camera flies from line to line, with sing-along glow, particles, and theme-aware visuals.
releaseNotes.v0_5_27.lyricOffsetMemory.d: Manual lyric timeline adjustments are saved per song and restored automatically the next time it plays.
releaseNotes.v0_5_27.posterWallSearch.de: Poster-wall pages now support list search, direct typing, and a search gesture for quickly opening search.
releaseNotes.v0_6_0.intro: Here are the new features and improvements in version 0.6.0.
releaseNotes.v0_6_0.localLibraryV2.title: Local Library 2.0
releaseNotes.v0_6_0.localLibraryV2.descr: The local music library now uses a progressive poster-wall workflow for folders, albums, artists, and playlists, with stronger import, rescan, and cover-cache handling.
releaseNotes.v0_6_0.entityEditing.title: Artist and Album Entity Editing
releaseNotes.v0_6_0.entityEditing.descri: Rename displayed identities, search and merge duplicates, or move selected songs into new or existing artist and album entities.
releaseNotes.v0_6_0.unifiedSearch.title: Unified Search and Navigation
releaseNotes.v0_6_0.unifiedSearch.descri: The search workspace covers NetEase, local, Navidrome, and the current queue, while navigation history, map view, and detail links make browsing more continuous.
releaseNotes.v0_6_0.metadataMatching.des: Local songs now have duration-assisted matching, batch metadata and cover organization, manual online matching, and reliable recovery of original local information.
releaseNotes.v0_6_0.dailyRecommendations: NetEase daily recommendations can be browsed, managed, and queued directly, and playlist editing now has smoother interaction feedback.
releaseNotes.v0_6_0.visualizerBackground: Latent and Nomand backgrounds add static mode, subtitle readability overlays, configurable color sources, beat response, and unified background settings and commands.
releaseNotes.v0_6_0.dioramaRework.title: Diorama Particle Rework
releaseNotes.v0_6_0.dioramaRework.descri: Diorama now offers ripple-driven point-cloud and corridor modes, more particle shapes, keyword coloring, and controls for density and glow.
releaseNotes.v0_6_1.intro: Here are the new features and improvements in version 0.6.1.
releaseNotes.v0_6_1.settingsRework.title: Redesigned Settings Page
releaseNotes.v0_6_1.settingsRework.descr: A completely redesigned settings interface with cleaner structure, logical grouping, and improved usability.
releaseNotes.v0_6_1.autoHideChrome.title: Auto-Hide Controls
releaseNotes.v0_6_1.autoHideChrome.descr: Optionally toggle auto-hiding for the top titlebar and player return button when idle.
releaseNotes.v0_6_1.voiceInputPause.desc: Automatically pause playback when using Windows voice typing, available in Lab Settings.
releaseNotes.v0_6_1.obsStaticLink.title: OBS Static Link Sharing
releaseNotes.v0_6_1.obsStaticLink.descri: Web version now supports generating and sharing static OBS overlay links for streaming setups.
userGuide.title: Welcome to Folia
userGuide.subtitle: Here are some tips to help you navigate.
userGuide.commandPalette.title: Command Palette
userGuide.commandPalette.desc: Press the "s" key on the playback page to open the Command Palette and access commands quickly.
userGuide.typeToSearch.title: Instant Search
userGuide.typeToSearch.desc: Press any key in a song list to instantly start searching.
userGuide.posterSearch.entryDesc: When a song poster wall is focused, type letters, numbers, or Chinese characters to search the current list.
userGuide.posterSearch.escapeDesc: Press Esc to close the poster-wall search panel.
userGuide.theme.title: Color themes
userGuide.theme.desc: Customize Folia with your own light and dark color themes, or generate an AI theme from the current song.
userGuide.theme.customDesc: Open Theme Park from visual settings or the command palette to edit and save custom light and dark colors.
userGuide.theme.aiDesc: When AI theme settings are configured, Folia can create song-aware colors and optionally auto-apply cached song themes.
userGuide.clickThrough.title: Click-through recovery
userGuide.clickThrough.desc: When click-through is enabled, you can use the system tray icon to switch it if the window controls are hidden or hard to reach.
userGuide.clickThrough.trayDesc: Right-click the Folia system tray icon, then choose the click-through option to turn it on or off.
userGuide.clickThrough.lockDesc: You can also move to the top titlebar hotspot to reveal the lock button, then click it to turn click-through off.
userGuide.page2Subtitle: Master shortcuts for the best experience.
userGuide.shortcutsPageSubtitle: Keyboard controls available on the player page.
userGuide.commandsDesc: You can trigger commands by typing English, Chinese characters, or Pinyin.
userGuide.ready.title: Ready to Go
userGuide.ready.subtitle: Enjoy your music journey with Folia.
aiHelp.title: Need help?
aiHelp.description: Check the Folia documentation first. If the issue remains unresolved, copy the prompt below and ask an AI model for help.
aiHelp.docsDescription: Find usage instructions, configuration details, and troubleshooting guidance.
aiHelp.askAiDescription: Describe your issue, then paste this prompt so the AI can use Folia documentation and source code as context.
aiHelp.usageHint: How to use it: open the official site for the model you use, describe your specific problem first, then paste this prompt below your question and send both together.
aiHelp.copyPromptDesc: Copy the prompt and paste it into any AI model to generate your theme.
